tours.name: Paris City of Light Break
overview: Fall under the spell of Paris on this five-day city break. Ascend the Eiffel Tower for sweeping views, wander the masterpiece-filled halls of the Louvre and stroll the grand boulevards from the Arc de Triomphe to Notre-Dame.
Sip coffee in a Left Bank café, cruise the Seine at dusk and lose yourself in the artistic lanes of Montmartre. Elegant, romantic and endlessly inspiring, Paris is a city made to be savoured.

tours.name: Maldives Overwater Retreat
overview: Slow down to island time on this indulgent Maldives escape. Wake to the lap of the lagoon beneath your overwater villa, slip straight into the warm water from your private deck and drift over technicolour reefs teeming with life.

Snorkel alongside manta rays, dine under the stars on a sandbank and let the resort's spa melt away the world. This is the Maldives at its most serene — pure white sand, endless blue and nothing on the agenda but bliss.

Feast on round-the-clock dim sum, escape to a tranquil island monastery and watch the skyline erupt in the nightly Symphony of Lights. A thrilling blend of old and new awaits at every turn.

destinations.name: California
description: California stretches from misty redwood forests to sun-drenched Pacific beaches, taking in glittering cities and golden vineyards along the way. San Francisco's bay, LA's glamour and Yosemite's cliffs all share one state.
Cruise the Pacific Coast Highway, taste your way through Napa Valley and chase endless summer along the coast. California is the original land of dreams and wide-open road trips.

destinations.name: Bangkok
description: Bangkok is Thailand's electric capital, a city of gilded temples, floating markets and skyline rooftop bars. The Grand Palace and Wat Arun glitter beside the winding Chao Phraya River.
Dive into the buzz of Chatuchak Market, sample world-famous street food and cruise the canals of the old town. Bangkok blends ancient tradition with modern energy at every turn.

destinations.name: Tokyo
description: Tokyo is a mesmerising blend of hyper-modern and deeply traditional, where neon-lit skyscrapers stand beside tranquil shrines and manicured gardens. Shibuya's crossing, Asakusa's temples and Akihabara's glow all coexist.
Savour everything from Michelin-starred sushi to backstreet ramen, then escape to a peaceful tea garden. Endlessly inventive and impeccably orderly, Tokyo rewards every kind of explorer.

destinations.name: Spain
description: Spain bursts with sun-soaked plazas, passionate flamenco and world-class cuisine. From Gaudí's Barcelona to the Moorish palaces of Andalusia, history and creativity meet at every corner.
Wander tapas bars late into the night, soak up Mediterranean beaches and join festivals that fill the streets with colour. Spain's warmth and zest for life are utterly contagious.

destinations.name: Maldives
description: The Maldives is a string of more than a thousand coral islands scattered across the Indian Ocean, each ringed by turquoise lagoons and powder-white sand. Overwater villas, house reefs, and endless horizons make it the definition of barefoot luxury.

Snorkelers and divers share the water with manta rays, whale sharks, and kaleidoscopic reef fish. Above the surface, glassy calm waters and spectacular sunsets create a serene, romantic retreat unlike anywhere else.

destinations.name: Hong Kong
description: Hong Kong is a dazzling collision of East and West, where a skyline of glass towers rises above buzzing street markets and centuries-old temples. The Star Ferry, Victoria Peak and neon-lit harbour define its electric energy.
Beyond the city, green hiking trails, outlying islands and tranquil monasteries offer surprising calm. Add legendary dim sum and round-the-clock dining, and Hong Kong never stops delighting.

destinations.name: Thailand
description: Thailand welcomes travellers with golden temples, emerald jungles and some of the friendliest smiles on earth. From the chaos of Bangkok to the serene beaches of the south, the Land of Smiles offers endless variety.
Feast on fragrant street food, explore ancient ruins in Ayutthaya and unwind on palm-fringed islands. Rich culture, warm hospitality and tropical beauty make every visit unforgettable.

destinations.name: Paris
description: Paris, the City of Light, pairs grand boulevards and storied monuments with an effortless everyday romance. From the Eiffel Tower to the galleries of the Louvre, every quarter tells its own story.
Linger over coffee in a Left Bank café, drift along the Seine at dusk and lose yourself in Montmartre's winding lanes. Art, fashion and timeless elegance make Paris endlessly captivating.

faqs.question: How do I book a tour with Travlla?
faqs.answer: Simply browse our tours, choose your preferred destination and dates, then complete the booking online in a few easy steps. You will receive an instant confirmation email with all the details of your trip.

faqs.question: Can I customise an existing tour package?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Many of our tours can be tailored to your interests, pace and budget. Contact our travel team and we will craft a personalised itinerary just for you.

faqs.question: What is included in the tour price?
faqs.answer: Each tour clearly lists what is included, typically accommodation, guided activities, selected meals and local transfers. Flights and personal expenses are usually not included unless stated otherwise.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, bank transfers and secure online payments. A deposit is required to confirm your booking, with the balance due before departure.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqs.answer: Cancellation terms vary by tour. In most cases, cancellations made well in advance are eligible for a partial or full refund. Please review the specific terms for your booking or contact our support team for assistance.

faqs.question: Do I need travel insurance?
faqs.answer: We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance for every trip. It protects you against unexpected events such as trip cancellation, medical emergencies and lost luggage.

faqs.question: Are your tours suitable for solo travellers?
faqs.answer: Yes! Many of our travellers join solo. Group tours are a great way to meet like-minded people, and our guides ensure everyone feels welcome and included throughout the journey.

faqs.question: What should I pack for my trip?
faqs.answer: After booking, we provide a detailed packing list tailored to your destination and the season. As a rule, pack light, bring comfortable footwear and don't forget travel documents and any required medication.

faqs.question: How experienced are your tour guides?
faqs.answer: All of our guides are certified local experts with years of experience. They are passionate about sharing the history, culture and hidden gems of each destination.

faqs.question: How can I contact customer support?
faqs.answer: Our support team is available 24/7 by phone, email and live chat. Whether you have a question before booking or need help during your trip, we are always here for you.
